about: RIWI Corp. operates as a trend-tracking and prediction technology firm in the United States, Europe, Canada, and internationally. Its patented cloud-based software solution provides a digital intelligence platform to clients seeking real-time consumer and citizen sentiment data. The company offers subscription products, such as RIWI compass to gauge the extent of political, macroeconomic, and geopolitical risks; RIWI voices of Ukraine monitor that access insights on the availability of food, medical supplies, electricity, and financial assistance; and Clinician and Patient Experience Registry (CaPER), a platform that captures invaluable perspectives that empowers healthcare stakeholders with actionable, real-time insights. It also provides data solutions, including RIWI track for capturing and assessing large samples of data; RIWI test, a message testing tool; RIWI audience to scale online engagement of content marketing, educational platforms, and other initiatives; RIWI rapid response that assess critical situations; and RIWI omni to source answers to a questions using random domain intercept technology, as well as advertising, packaging, and product solutions. In addition, the company offers CoolTool, a platform for neuromarketing and market research; RIWI Sampling Technologies, including random domain intercept technology; RIWI Respondent Marketplace provides river sampling, allowing researchers to access profiled data; and RIWI Communities that offers online survey respondents, in-person participants, social media sentiment, or specialized B2B audiences. The company serves government and public sectors, financial services and economics, healthcare and life sciences, international development, and consumer services industries, as well as academic institutions and independent researchers. RIWI Corporation was incorporated in 2009 and is headquartered in Toronto, Canada.
